policy: Copied ESM implementations from the recorded Base commit, with the listed trigger-aware migration validation correction. Public documentation and a mail-interface comment omit historical development coordination notes. Project-specific adapters live in scripts/deployment. Runtime source snapshots select the unmodified upstream files recorded in edition.json; local effective source is covered by sources.lock.json.

adaptations.reason: Replace raw transaction-keyword matching with bounded SQL token/control-state validation so legitimate CREATE TRIGGER BEGIN/END bodies and CASE expressions in immutable migrations are admitted. Preserve controller-ledger denial, reject transaction controls (including END and RELEASE), ATTACH/DETACH/VACUUM, and unterminated tokens or NUL that could swallow the appended ledger update. No SQL migration bytes change.
adaptations.verification: scripts/deployment/tests/migrations.test.mjs exercises all eleven actual Vector migrations through the controller against real SQLite, zero-write repeat, trigger enforcement and appended/hidden unsafe controls. Existing Base security and deployment tests remain unchanged.

adaptations.reason: R2 documented explicit per_page=100, order=name/direction=asc and start_after pagination permits optional result_info without fabricating metadata. Short pages with continuation and nonincreasing names fail.
